# NTPS Nurses and Midwives Enterprise Agreement

These Bulletins only apply to employees covered by [NTPS Nurses and Midwives 2022 - 2026 Enterprise Agreement PDF (2.4 MB)](https://ocpe.nt.gov.au/media/documents/nt-public-sector-employment-information-about-ntps-employment/information-about-ntps-employment/ntps-nurses-and-midwives-2022-2026-enterprise-agreement.PDF "Follow link").

Read the [Notice of Employee Representational Rights DOCX (33.1 KB)](https://ocpe.nt.gov.au/__data/assets/word_doc/0009/1597581/notice-employee-representational-rights.DOCX).

### Bulletin 1 - enterprise agreement negotiations to commence - issued 9 March 2026

This bulletin 1 only applies to employees covered by the Northern Territory Public Sector Nurses and Midwives 2022 - 2026 Enterprise Agreement

[Read more\\
about Bulletin 1 - enterprise agreement negotiations to commence - issued 9 March 2026](https://ocpe.nt.gov.au/employment-terms-and-conditions/current-enterprise-agreements/enterprise-agreement-negotiations/ntps-nurses-and-midwives-enterprise-agreement/bulletin-1)
